bio: The location is simply divine! The restaurant of Hotel Château Gütsch affords a breathtaking view over the city and the lake surrounded by mountains, especially from the large terrace – the perfect setting for a romantic dinner! Inspired by the hotel's 140-year history, the interior design draws on Belle Époque design elements but also incorporates nods to the natural surroundings. Fresh, modern accents successfully bridge the gap to the present day. The cuisine is influenced by the culinary traditions of France and the Mediterranean. Opt for the Chef's Choice set menu or order à la carte. At midday, the shorter Time for Lunch set menu is available, along with other dishes....
